note: 2026-11-13 OIDC 4.1.0 source/graph reassessment: auth.rs is unchanged. Compared upstream 4.0.1 and 4.1.0 core/crypto.rs verification operations: RSA still constructs RsaPublicKey from public JWKS and verifies PKCS#1/PSS signatures, with no production private signing/decryption or client assertion. rsa remains 0.9.10 and is not remediated by this upgrade; RustSec now lists >=0.10.0 as patched, outside this OIDC dependency range. Sole production consumer remains openidconnect under sandhi-proxy; neither binding graph includes RSA. The synthetic test-only private key remains disposable. Existing 2026-11-18 expiry is unchanged; independent review is required before adoption. Integration reassessment source combines the explicit resource-audience selector with OIDC 4.1.0; the selector changes only exact introspection audience matching, without adding signing, decryption, client assertions, or a cryptographic consumer. Independent exact-source review is required before adoption. 2026-11-13 optional inbound authentication amendment: independently reviewed the frozen auth.rs change adding only AuthMode selection and unauthenticated session metadata. Configured OIDC still takes precedence; invalid or unavailable selected OIDC is refused rather than falling back. Production token exchange, ID-token verification, introspection client authentication and JWKS/public-key operations are unchanged. The starter principal adds no private RSA signing/decryption, JWE, client assertion or additional cryptographic consumer. Locked openidconnect 4.1.0/rsa 0.9.10 and patched crypto-bigint graph checks passed for proxy and both binding workspaces. This updates only the reviewed adapter fingerprint/applicability note, not vulnerability status, ignore policy or the existing 2026-11-18 expiry. Full combined-source release review and tests remain separate.
